jei.velorise_teyvat_bosses.ruin_sub:
Dropped by Ruin Nautilus (Ocean Arena).

Outdoor Assembly (4 Parts): Right-click water or ground with Ruin Submersible Hull (1/4), then weld Cockpit, Propeller, and Torpedo Pods onto it.

Controls: W/S (3D Look Dive/Climb), A/D (Strafe), Space/Ctrl (Ballast), LMB (Homing Torpedoes), RMB (Sonar Pulse), R (Hydro-Jet Boost), F (Floodlight).
Refuel: Sea Lantern / Prismarine Bricks / Redstone Block. Repair: Iron Ingot. Shift+Pickaxe to disassemble.
jei.velorise_teyvat_bosses.ruin_mech:
Dropped by Ruin Guard (Thousand Winds Temple Arena).

Outdoor Assembly (5 Parts): Right-click ground with Ruin Mech Core (1/5), then weld Left Arm, Right Arm, Left Leg, and Right Leg onto it.

Controls: LMB Tap/Double/Hold (Clap / 3-Hit / Cyclone), RMB Tap/Double/Hold (Stomp / Leap / 6x Missiles), Space Tap/Hold (Boost Leap), MMB (Hard Lock-On).
Recharge: Redstone Block. Repair: Iron Ingot / Iron Block. Shift+Pickaxe to disassemble.
jei.velorise_teyvat_bosses.cryo_turret:
Dropped by Cryo Regisvine (Underground Ice Cavern Arena).

Outdoor Assembly (3 Parts): Right-click ground with Cryo Turret Root (1/3), then attach Stem and Corolla.

Function: Automated Cryo base-defense turret that fires frost darts at nearby hostiles. Shift+Pickaxe to disassemble and recover all parts.
jei.velorise_teyvat_bosses.anemo_cube:
Dropped by Anemo Hypostasis (2–4 cubes per defeat).

Outdoor Assembly (8 Cubes): Right-click a single block on the ground 8 times to stack all 8 cubes from bottom to top. Completing 8/8 permanently binds the Anemo Cube Companion pet to you!

Behavior: Follows & kites enemies smartly, launching 1 physical cube per shot (Anemo damage + Swirl with Velorise's Staves, or normal damage + wind knockback standalone). Recharges all 8 cubes after emptying. Right-click to toggle Follow/Guard; Shift+Pickaxe to disassemble.

jei.velorise_teyvat_bosses.geo_driller:
Crafted using Primordial Jade dropped by Primo Geovishap (Subterranean Lair).

Outdoor Assembly (3 Parts): Place Geo Driller Chassis on the ground, then weld Bore Head & Reactor Engine onto it. Right-click with 1 or 2 vanilla Chests (27 / 54 slots) for auto-mining storage, and apply Enchanted Books (Fortune, Silk Touch, Efficiency, Sweeping Edge, Unbreaking) to upgrade the Bore Head.

Controls: R or LMB (Toggle Drill), RMB (Forward Drill Surge), Space (Cycle Pitch: Level / Down / Up), B (Toggle Auto-Pave using cargo stone), F (Headlight). Refuel: Redstone Dust / Block / Condensed Redstone Block. Repair: Iron Ingot / Iron Block. Shift+RMB opens cargo; Shift+Pickaxe disassembles.

jei.velorise_teyvat_bosses.primordial_ja:
Dropped by Primo Geovishap (2–3 Primordial Jade per defeat from the Trounce Blossom).

Dual Progression Uses:
• Combat Branch: Forge Geo Scale Ingots to craft the Primo Geovishap Dragon-Scale Armor set (2-Piece Resistance I & reflects Primordial Shower; 4-Piece Fire Resistance & auto-recharging +8 HP Geo Shield).
• Survival Branch: Combine with Iron, Copper, Diamond & Redstone to craft the 3 modular parts of the Geo Tunnel Driller.
jei.velorise_teyvat_bosses.geovishap_arm:
Forged from Primordial Jade & Geo Scale Ingots (dropped by Primo Geovishap).

• 2-Piece Bonus (Geo Scales): Permanent Resistance I and counts as an active Geo Shield to reflect Primo Geovishap's Primordial Shower.
• 4-Piece Bonus (Primordial Aegis): Permanent Fire Resistance and automatically recharges a +8 HP Absorption Geo Shield every 15 seconds.
Fireproof with high toughness & knockback resistance; repair with Geo Scale Ingots or Primordial Jade.
